subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Lesson 4: Book club – A holiday on the Moon (science fiction)
outcomes: Know the features of a science fiction story.
Answer questions about the family's holiday on the Moon.
Use phrasal verbs: get on, get off, take off, put on.

tf.s: Science fiction stories are often about the future.
tf.why: Yes, they show a future world.

tf.s: In science fiction, the world is often different from ours.
tf.why: Yes, like a hotel on the Moon.

tf.s: The family went to the launch pad by plane.
The family stayed in a space hotel on the Moon.
tf.why: Yes, they stayed in a space hotel.

tf.s: The food on the Moon was very fresh.
When they landed, they got on the rocket.
tf.why: When they landed, they got off the rocket.

tf.s: The Moon holiday was perfect for everyone.
tf.why: There were problems, and Issa wanted to go home.

tf.s: The opposite of get on is get off.
tf.why: Yes, get on a train, get off a train.

tf.s: Science fiction stories are always about things in the past.
tf.why: They are usually about the future.

o: a place where rockets take off
boxes.why: Rockets start their journey from a launch pad.

boxes.q: Where did they stay on the Moon?
boxes.why: They stayed in a space hotel.

boxes.q: What do people wear on their heads outside on the Moon?
boxes.why: Helmets help people breathe and stay safe.

boxes.q: Which one is a phrasal verb?
A plane leaves the ground. It …
You ___ your helmet before you go outside.
Complete: We got ___ the train at the launch pad.
boxes.why: You get off when you arrive.

boxes.q: Complete: Take ___ your helmet when you are inside.
boxes.why: Take off = remove clothes or a helmet.

boxes.q: Which is NOT a problem on the Moon holiday?
boxes.why: The hotel had a window to see Mars.

hunt.q: Boy who wants to go home

mcq.q: What are two features of a science fiction story?
o: It is in the future and the world is different.
It is true and about the past.
It has animals that talk and teach a lesson.

mcq.q: Which phrasal verb means 'wear clothes or a helmet'?
How did the family travel when they landed on the Moon?
Where did the rocket leave from?
mcq.why: Rockets take off from a launch pad.

mcq.q: Complete: The rocket will take ___ at 9 o'clock.
Complete: Please get ___ the bus quickly. It's leaving!
mcq.why: You get on a bus to travel.

o: Children live in a city under the sea in 2200.
A platypus can't join any animal group.
A family visits a museum in Salalah.
A fact file about the stick insect.
mcq.why: It is in the future in a very different world.

mcq.q: Why wasn't the Moon holiday perfect?
o: There wasn't much to do and the food wasn't fresh.
The hotel was too big and the food was fresh.
It was too hot on the Moon.
mcq.why: Good! These are reasons from the story.

mcq.q: Issa wants to go home. What does this tell us about the Moon holiday?
o: It wasn't as good as he hoped.
mcq.why: Wanting to go home shows he wasn't happy.

mcq.q: Which is a good reason to want a Moon holiday?
o: I want to see the Earth from space.
I want fresh food every day.
I want lots of things to do.
mcq.why: The story says the other things were problems.
